Calculate velocity limit based on acceleration limit for a float From SUVAT we have that v^2 = u^2 + 2*a*s.

Assuming a is constant we can calculate the velocity bound given the position error and the acceleration limit. This bounding also assumes that we want to arrive at the waypoint with zero velocity which might be untrue.

Spin transition manoeuvre state machine.

Sets the fault flags and the yaw rate reference. Spin up: UP_RAMP -> (|r| >= release) fault spin_man_pair -> UP_BLEND -> IDLE Spin down: DOWN_SLOW -> (|r| < release - gap) unfault the faulted pair -> DOWN_BLEND -> DOWN_RAMP -> (|r| < done) IDLE

Enforce valid spin protection / spin trim parameters (they can be changed in flight from the settings).
